# Anchor Domain

The Anchor Doors are the oldest things in the Severed Lands. They were built before human memory, before the Rift, before the world fractured. No one knows who built them. No one knows how they work. But everyone knows what they do: they hold reality in place.

Clerics of the Anchor Domain don't pray to gods. They pray to the Doors. Their faith is in stability — the sacred truth that some things refuse to fall apart. In a world where the Rift bends geography and corrupts creatures, an Anchor cleric is the one patch of ground you can trust.

## Domain Spells

| Cleric Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | Sanctuary, Shield of Faith |
| 3rd | Aid, Warding Bond |
| 5th | Protection from Energy, Magic Circle |
| 7th | Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith |
| 9th | Wall of Stone, Hallow |

## Anchor Point

*1st-level Anchor Domain feature*

You can spend 1 minute sanctifying an area, creating an Anchor Point — a 15-foot radius of stable ground. While inside an Anchor Point, allies have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, charmed, or moved against their will.

Anchor Points last until you finish a long rest. You can maintain a number of Anchor Points at once equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Creating a new one beyond this limit causes the oldest to fade.

## Channel Divinity: Fortify Anchor

*2nd-level Anchor Domain feature*

As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to supercharge one Anchor Point you currently occupy. For 1 minute, the radius doubles to 30 feet, and any ally starting their turn inside gains temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier. The air hums with the resonance of an activated Door.

## Reactive Anchor

*6th-level Anchor Domain feature*

Your ground refuses to let anyone fall. When an ally inside one of your Anchor Points drops to 0 hit points and isn't killed outright, you can use your reaction to stabilize them immediately. They regain hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your cleric level.

Once a creature benefits from this feature, they cannot benefit from it again until they finish a short or long rest.

## Potent Spellcasting

*8th-level Anchor Domain feature*

You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any cleric cantrip.

## Anchor of Self

*17th-level Anchor Domain feature*

You have become what you worship. You are an Anchor Point — permanently. The sanctified 15-foot radius emanates from your body at all times, requiring no preparation or maintenance. You carry stable ground wherever you walk.

You are a living Door. In a world where everything bends, you are the one thing that doesn't.
